eyebrow.en: Session Replay · Survival Attribution · One Command

headline.zh:
你的 Agent 改了那么多
到底哪几行活到了最后
headline.en:
Your agent wrote a lot
Which lines actually survived

sub.zh: 把一个编码 Agent 会话的每一轮改动，按 git HEAD 归因——存活、改写、还是消亡，一眼看清。
sub.en: Score every turn of a coding-agent session by git-HEAD survival: survived, churned, or partial — at a glance.

title.zh: 一轮一行，存活还是废弃

body.zh: 解析完整会话日志，逐行 blame 到当前 HEAD——加的代码是活着的、被改写了、还是已经消失。
body.en: Parse a finished session log, blame each added line against the repo's current HEAD — survived, churned, or gone.

title.zh: 红绿热力图，一眼定位浪费

body.zh: 终端红绿热力图，哪些轮次在白改、哪些轮次真有产出，不用翻日志。
body.en: Terminal red/green heatmap — which turns were wasted, which were productive, without reading logs.

title.zh: 单二进制，信创内网也能跑
title.en: Single binary, runs on air-gapped boxes

body.zh: 纯 Go 编译，不依赖系统 git，零联网零账号——信创气隙盒上直接运行。
body.en: Pure-Go single binary, no system git, zero network, zero accounts — runs on air-gapped boxes.

sub.zh: 一条命令，看清你的 Agent 到底产出了什么。
sub.en: One command, see what your agent actually shipped.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 单二进制 · 信创可用
